issue.title: Agent onboarding docs, PR workflow tooling & Android-only scope
issue.body:
## Summary

Establish agent/contributor onboarding documentation, PR workflow tooling, and formalize the **Android-only** scope for Fluent Mobile.

## What shipped

- **Agent onboarding docs** (`docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`) covering setup, architecture, risks, and common tasks.
- **PR workflow tooling** — slash commands / PR helpers and team PR conventions (`[TICKET-ID]: Description`).
- **Android-only scope** documented and reflected across config and docs.

## Attribution

Delivered by @mattrace-gloo across [PR #43](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/43) and [PR #56](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/56) (both merged).

## Status

**Completed** — closing as completed. Tracking/credit issue.

Refs #43, #56.
